mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM o_goods_sku s WHERE s.id > 0

SELECT i.id AS inventoryId, COUNT(b.id) AS batchCount, COALESCE(SUM(b.current_qty),0) AS batchQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.id IS NOT NULL AND (b.current_qty IS NULL OR b.current_qty < 0 OR b.sku_id IS NULL OR b.sku_id != i.sku_id OR b.warehouse_id IS NULL OR b.warehouse_id != i.warehouse_id OR b.merchant_id IS NULL OR b.merchant_id != i.merchant_id OR b.shop_id IS NULL OR b.shop_id != i.shop_id OR b.stock_status IS NULL OR b.stock_status != i.stock_status) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS invalidBatches FROM o_goods_inventory i LEFT JOIN o_goods_inventory_batch b ON b.inventory_id=i.id WHERE i.id IN #{id} GROUP BY i.id ORDER BY i.id
mapper.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM o_goods_inventory q LEFT JOIN o_goods_inventory_batch b ON b.inventory_id=q.id WHERE q.sku_id=s.id AND COALESCE(q.is_delete,0)=0 AND q.stock_status=1 AND q.merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND q.shop_id=#{shopId} AND q.warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} GROUP BY q.id,q.quantity,q.sku_id,q.warehouse_id,q.merchant_id,q.shop_id,q.stock_status HAVING COUNT(b.id)=0 OR COALESCE(SUM(b.current_qty),0) <> q.quantity OR SUM(CASE WHEN b.id IS NOT NULL AND (b.current_qty IS NULL OR b.current_qty < 0 OR b.sku_id IS NULL OR b.sku_id <> q.sku_id OR b.warehouse_id IS NULL OR b.warehouse_id <> q.warehouse_id OR b.merchant_id IS NULL OR b.merchant_id <> q.merchant_id OR b.shop_id IS NULL OR b.shop_id <> q.shop_id OR b.stock_status IS NULL OR b.stock_status <> q.stock_status) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0)

SELECT s.id AS skuId, s.sku_code AS skuCode, s.goods_name AS goodsName, s.sku_name AS skuName, s.status AS productStatus, s.low_qty AS lowQty, COUNT(i.id) AS inventoryRows, SUM(CASE WHEN i.stock_status=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS goodRows, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.stock_status=1 THEN CONCAT(i.warehouse_id, ':', i.merchant_id, ':', i.shop_id) END) AS distinctGoodScopes, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.stock_status=1 THEN i.warehouse_id END) AS distinctWarehouses, SUM(CASE WHEN i.stock_status=1 THEN i.available_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS availableQuantity, SUM(CASE WHEN i.stock_status=1 THEN i.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN i.stock_status=1 THEN i.locked_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS lockedQuantity, SUM(CASE WHEN i.stock_status=1 AND (i.available_quantity IS NULL OR i.quantity IS NULL OR i.locked_quantity IS NULL OR i.available_quantity < 0 OR i.quantity < 0 OR i.locked_quantity < 0 OR i.available_quantity <> i.quantity - i.locked_quantity) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalidRows, CASE WHEN THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS emptyInventoryScope, CASE WHEN THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS batchIssue FROM o_goods_sku s LEFT JOIN o_goods_inventory i ON i.sku_id=s.id AND COALESCE(i.is_delete,0)=0 AND i.merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND i.shop_id=#{shopId} AND i.warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} WHERE s.id > 0 GROUP BY s.id,s.sku_code,s.goods_name,s.sku_name,s.status,s.low_qty
mapper.select: ORDER BY CASE WHEN COUNT(i.id)=0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN i.stock_status=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0 THEN 2 WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.stock_status=1 AND (i.available_quantity IS NULL OR i.quantity IS NULL OR i.locked_quantity IS NULL OR i.available_quantity < 0 OR i.quantity < 0 OR i.locked_quantity < 0 OR i.available_quantity <> i.quantity-i.locked_quantity) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0 THEN 0 WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.stock_status=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.stock_status=1 THEN CONCAT(i.warehouse_id, ':', i.merchant_id, ':', i.shop_id) END) THEN 0 WHEN THEN 0 WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.stock_status=1 THEN i.available_quantity ELSE 0 END)<=0 OR THEN 1 WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.stock_status=1 THEN i.warehouse_id END)>1 THEN 2 WHEN s.low_qty>0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN i.stock_status=1 THEN i.available_quantity ELSE 0 END)<=s.low_qty THEN 3 WHEN COALESCE(s.low_qty,0)<=0 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, s.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT s.id AS skuId, s.sku_code AS skuCode, s.goods_name AS goodsName, s.sku_name AS skuName, s.status AS productStatus, s.low_qty AS lowQty, COUNT(i.id) AS inventoryRows, SUM(CASE WHEN i.stock_status=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS goodRows, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.stock_status=1 THEN CONCAT(i.warehouse_id, ':', i.merchant_id, ':', i.shop_id) END) AS distinctGoodScopes, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.stock_status=1 THEN i.warehouse_id END) AS distinctWarehouses, SUM(CASE WHEN i.stock_status=1 THEN i.available_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS availableQuantity, SUM(CASE WHEN i.stock_status=1 THEN i.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN i.stock_status=1 THEN i.locked_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS lockedQuantity, SUM(CASE WHEN i.stock_status=1 AND (i.available_quantity IS NULL OR i.quantity IS NULL OR i.locked_quantity IS NULL OR i.available_quantity < 0 OR i.quantity < 0 OR i.locked_quantity < 0 OR i.available_quantity <> i.quantity - i.locked_quantity) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalidRows, CASE WHEN THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS emptyInventoryScope, CASE WHEN THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS batchIssue FROM o_goods_sku s LEFT JOIN o_goods_inventory i ON i.sku_id=s.id AND COALESCE(i.is_delete,0)=0 AND i.merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND i.shop_id=#{shopId} AND i.warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} WHERE s.id > 0 GROUP BY s.id,s.sku_code,s.goods_name,s.sku_name,s.status,s.low_qty ORDER BY CASE WHEN COUNT(i.id)=0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN i.stock_status=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0 THEN 2 WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.stock_status=1 AND (i.available_quantity IS NULL OR i.quantity IS NULL OR i.locked_quantity IS NULL OR i.available_quantity < 0 OR i.quantity < 0 OR i.locked_quantity < 0 OR i.available_quantity <> i.quantity-i.locked_quantity) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>0 THEN 0 WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.stock_status=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)>COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.stock_status=1 THEN CONCAT(i.warehouse_id, ':', i.merchant_id, ':', i.shop_id) END) THEN 0 WHEN THEN 0 WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.stock_status=1 THEN i.available_quantity ELSE 0 END)<=0 OR THEN 1 WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.stock_status=1 THEN i.warehouse_id END)>1 THEN 2 WHEN s.low_qty>0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN i.stock_status=1 THEN i.available_quantity ELSE 0 END)<=s.low_qty THEN 3 WHEN COALESCE(s.low_qty,0)<=0 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, s.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT i.id AS itemId, i.stock_in_id AS stockInId, i.source_no AS sourceNo, i.source_item_id AS sourceItemId, i.sku_id AS skuId, i.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, i.merchant_id AS merchantId, i.shop_id AS shopId, i.quantity AS quantity, i.in_quantity AS inQuantity, (i.quantity - i.in_quantity) AS remainingQuantity, i.status AS itemStatus, i.update_time AS updateTime FROM erp_stock_in_item i JOIN erp_stock_in h ON h.id = i.stock_in_id WHERE i.sku_id = #{skuId} AND i.stock_in_type = 1 AND h.stock_in_type = 1 AND i.merchant_id = h.merchant_id AND i.shop_id = h.shop_id AND i.quantity > i.in_quantity AND i.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND h.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND h.shop_id = #{shopId} ORDER BY i.id DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT p.id AS orderId, p.order_num AS orderNum, p.status AS orderStatus, i.id AS itemId, i.quantity AS quantity, p.warehouse_id AS warehouseId FROM erp_purchase_order p JOIN erp_purchase_order_item i ON i.order_id = p.id WHERE i.spec_id = #{skuId} AND COALESCE(i.is_delete,0)=0 AND i.merchant_id=p.merchant_id AND i.shop_id=p.shop_id AND p.status IN (1,2,3,101,102) AND i.quantity > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_stock_in h JOIN erp_stock_in_item s ON s.stock_in_id=h.id WHERE h.stock_in_type=1 AND h.source_id=p.id AND s.stock_in_type=1 AND s.source_item_id=i.id AND s.sku_id=i.spec_id AND h.merchant_id=p.merchant_id AND h.shop_id=p.shop_id AND s.merchant_id=p.merchant_id AND s.shop_id=p.shop_id) AND p.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND p.shop_id = #{shopId} ORDER BY p.id DESC, i.id DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT s.id,s.order_id,p.order_num,s.warehouse_id,s.ship_company,s.ship_num,s.ship_time,s.receipt_time,s.status FROM erp_purchase_order_ship s JOIN erp_purchase_order p ON p.id=s.order_id AND p.merchant_id=s.merchant_id AND p.shop_id=s.shop_id AND p.supplier_id=s.supplier_id WHERE p.status IN (1,2,3,101,102) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_purchase_order_item i WHERE i.order_id=p.id AND i.spec_id=#{skuId} AND COALESCE(i.is_delete,0)=0 AND i.merchant_id=p.merchant_id AND i.shop_id=p.shop_id) AND s.warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} AND p.merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND p.shop_id=#{shopId} ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT p.id AS order_id,p.order_num,p.status AS order_status,p.warehouse_id,p.merchant_id,p.shop_id, i.id AS item_id,i.quantity AS ordered_quantity, COUNT(s.id) AS task_count,COALESCE(SUM(s.quantity),0) AS task_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(s.in_quantity),0) AS received_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN s.id IS NOT NULL AND (s.quantity IS NULL OR s.in_quantity IS NULL OR s.quantity <= 0 OR s.in_quantity < 0 OR s.in_quantity > s.quantity OR s.status IS NULL OR s.status NOT IN (0,1,2) OR (s.status=2 AND s.quantity != s.in_quantity) OR (s.status IN (0,1) AND s.quantity=s.in_quantity) OR (s.status=0 AND s.in_quantity != 0) OR (s.status=1 AND s.in_quantity <= 0) OR s.warehouse_id IS NULL OR p.warehouse_id IS NULL OR s.warehouse_id != p.warehouse_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid_tasks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM erp_stock_in e WHERE e.stock_in_type=1 AND e.source_id=p.id) AS entry_count FROM erp_purchase_order p JOIN erp_purchase_order_item i ON i.order_id=p.id LEFT JOIN erp_stock_in h ON h.stock_in_type=1 AND h.source_id=p.id AND h.merchant_id=p.merchant_id AND h.shop_id=p.shop_id LEFT JOIN erp_stock_in_item s ON s.stock_in_id=h.id AND s.stock_in_type=1 AND s.source_item_id=i.id AND s.sku_id=i.spec_id AND s.merchant_id=p.merchant_id AND s.shop_id=p.shop_id WHERE i.spec_id=#{skuId} AND COALESCE(i.is_delete,0)=0 AND i.merchant_id=p.merchant_id AND i.shop_id=p.shop_id AND p.status IN (1,2,3,101,102) AND p.merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND p.shop_id=#{shopId} GROUP BY p.id,p.order_num,p.status,p.warehouse_id,p.merchant_id,p.shop_id,i.id,i.quantity ORDER BY p.id DESC,i.id DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT DISTINCT sku_id, sku_code, goods_name, sku_name FROM o_goods_inventory WHERE COALESCE(is_delete, 0) = 0 AND sku_id > 0 AND (LOCATE(#{keyword}, COALESCE(sku_code, '')) > 0 OR LOCATE(#{keyword}, COALESCE(goods_name, '')) > 0) AND merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND shop_id = #{shopId} ORDER BY sku_id, sku_code, goods_name, sku_name LIMIT 30
